title: Bounded Sync Channels
summary: Synchronous channels limit queue size and block senders when full.
lecture: Standard Rust channels are unbounded, growing indefinitely as messages are sent. A bounded channel created with `mpsc::sync_channel` has a fixed capacity.
Calling send on a full bounded channel blocks the sending thread until the receiving thread reads a message. This creates backpressure between producers and consumers.
You can use try_send to fail immediately instead of blocking when the channel buffer is at capacity.

example.caption: sync_channel creates a bounded sender and receiver.
